summary: Thursday night in Denver: two top-10 pass defenses, a short week and possible rain. Sharp money has pushed the total from 43.5 down to 40.5, so we lean Under and fade Bo Nix through the air.

legs.note: Two top-10 pass defenses and two bottom-tier third-down offenses. Denver is 1-4 to the Under and scores the fewest first-half points in the NFL. The line fell from 43.5 to 40.5 even with most bets on the Over. Short week, possible rain.

extra_legs.note: Averages 188 yards a game, threw for 123 last week, and his 5.8 yards per attempt is a career low. Seattle has the No. 1 pass defense at 151 yards a game. The line dropped from 209.5, so less cushion, but still under his average.
7 TDs in 5 games and scored in 4 of them. Denver may be missing CB Surtain, CB Moss and S Hufanga. Now +115, better than the even money we had.
extra_legs.status: Ankle, limited at practice. Expected to play; confirm on the final injury report
